sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note: original key authority and question/key order
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The retained th_solutions.pdf is headed 6th Asian Physics Olympiad, Pekanbaru–Indonesia2005, THEORETICAL COMPETITION, Questions and Solutions, FINAL VERSION and contains matching full worked solutions and marking schemes. The question cover carries an APhO.ORG digital-signature attestation. This transcription uses the retained event-branded final key, preserving the original bytes and printed defects. Native key pages2–6 label Gas Volume as a(3.0) and Small Oscillation as b(2.0); the question and the repeated stem label frequency a(2), volume b(3). The key’s letters/order and the question’s letters/order are both retained.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note: two printed swing alternatives and literal formulas
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The key prints Solution1 ending n=10/3 and ALTERNATE SOLUTION ending n=5. Its marking table prints both as paired alternatives. Both complete derivations survive without choosing or silently reconciling the two outcomes. Solution1 Eq2 lacks an equals sign between L_B and the following mr_u² angular-velocity term; Eq4 has a minus potential-energy term. The rubric also prints its own literal energy expressions. These are retained rather than substituted with an inferred correction.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note: literal magnetic-field result and reference
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The solenoid calculation prints B=4.24mT while its rubric prints4.23mT. Both values survive. The fringe-field derivation literally refers to figure4; the diagram captions remain2.4 and2.5, and its Eq9 uses ΔP_z while the rubric prints a total subscript. These source forms remain literal.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note: vector glyph correspondence and malformed native graphics
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: Native question pages10–11 show aberrant vector accents, and Figure2.4 contains an aberrant field icon. Personally viewed MuPDF and retained Poppler previews agree on those forms, so they are not represented as a detected loss peculiar to one renderer. The matching repeated prose on native key pages21–22 prints actual vector arrows; typed vector notation follows that retained source correspondence. All question diagrams and distinct key diagram versions preserve actual original pixels, including the malformed field icon and overlaid key Figures3.1,3.2,3.4. No graphic is redrawn or repaired.

sourceCaveatNotes.title: Reader note: literal mirror allocations and unnamed-point gap
sourceCaveatNotes.statement: The question and repeated stem give3A2.5points,3B2points,3C5.5points; the original marking tables giveA3.0,B2.0,C5.0. Native point allocations remain unchanged. Question3C and its key literally say atoms at point without naming the point; this original gap remains in both transcribed passages. The printed frequency equality0.5 and50% conclusion remain literal rather than replaced by a recomputed value. All14question pages,30key pages, four blank forms and all native rubric error-caps were personally read; no further companion is listed in the exact retained Theory archive folder.
